description:
⚡️ Sparky Steve – Making Electrical Simple. ⚡️

Whether you’re a first-year apprentice trying to wrap your head around the code or a homeowner looking to tackle a DIY project without blowing a fuse, you’re in the right place.

I’m Steve, a professional electrician on a mission to bridge the gap between "technical jargon" and "actually getting the job done." On this channel, we break down the complex world of electrical work into bite-sized, easy-to-follow tutorials and pro-tips.

What you’ll find here:

🛠 Apprentice Essentials: Master the tools, the code, and the tricks of the trade.

🏠 Homeowner How-To’s: Safe, step-by-step guides for lighting, outlets, and troubleshooting.

📘 Educational Resources: Exclusive deep-dives and e-books designed to take your skills to the next level.

I’ve brought the energy from TikTok & Instagram (@itssparkysteve) over to YouTube to give you the full-length lessons ppl been asking for.
